subject: reasoning
question:
Select the set in which the numbers are related in the same way as are the numbers of the following sets. (NOTE:

Operations should be performed on the whole numbers, without breaking down the numbers into its constituent digits. E.g. 13 – Operations on 13 such as adding/deleting/multiplying etc. to 13 can be performed. Breaking down 13 into 1 and 3 and then performing mathematical operations on 1 and 3 is not allowed)

(18, 28, 38)

(11,26, 41)
solution:
The logic followed here is:

Logic: (1st number + 3rd number) ÷ 2 = 2nd number.

Now,

For, (18, 28, 38)

⇒ (18 + 38) ÷ 2 = 56 ÷ 2 = 28.
